normalization.title: The Agent a Company Owns

source.dateNote: Source metadata reported in original public edition; no independent source-date revalidation.

normalization.overview: Riley Brown interviews Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch about V, Eve, reusable skills, tools, memory and a company-owned agent that survives individual conversations.
normalization.whyItMatters: Useful for teams considering shared agents. Watch the permission and memory discussion; skip the interview if you need independent productivity measurements or a deployment audit.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Own continuity while proving permission, replay, memory isolation and portability with synthetic tests. A readable agent folder does not itself enforce those boundaries.
normalization.falsification: Reconsider the recommendation if a controlled comparison on the stated task shows no benefit, or exposes permission failures, omitted evidence or greater cost than the ordinary workflow. See the original article for its specific proposed controls.
normalization.freshness: Historical references in this Reader were checked October 18, 2026. The Vercel memory changelog was checked October 19, 2026 for the narrowly bound claims below. This revision did not re-transcribe the source video, replicate a study, or verify later operational outcomes.
